notes: «- وهو ابن الحارث -» is an editor's gloss, left out; «أن بكيرا، حدثه» and «أن عبد الله بن أبي سلمة حدثه» are links by rule 5

«قال بكير وحدثني نافع، أنه سمع ابن عمر» carries a different saying (Ibn Umar's practice, after the Prophet's prohibition) with its own isnad: not a second route of this saying, so not written as one (rule 11)
